parties: NLC India Renewables Limited; OREDA (Odisha Renewable Energy Development Agency)
headline: NLC India Renewables signs JV with OREDA for green energy projects in Odisha
sum: NLC India Renewables and OREDA (Odisha Renewable Energy Development Agency) have signed a joint venture agreement to develop green energy (renewable) projects across Odisha. The JV marks NLC's strategic pivot toward renewable capacity alongside its traditional coal-based generation.
implication: Joint ventures between central PSUs and state-level renewable energy authorities represent the emerging model for decentralised green energy development; counsel must review PSU governance, Cabinet approval thresholds for foreign/domestic JV structures, and Odisha's renewable energy policy framework.
detail: NLC India Renewables Limited has entered a joint venture with OREDA Ltd., a state agency under the Government of Odisha, to develop and deploy green energy projects-principally wind and solar-across Odisha. The agreement was formalized on 24 June 2026. The JV structure reflects NLC's transition from coal-dominant generation to renewable capacity, aligning with India's National Action Plan on Climate Change and state renewable targets. No consideration amount or capacity targets were disclosed in the press release.
